hypotheses.title: Dual-Factor LEAPS VRP with Short-Term Reversion De-correlation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Blends the 1.41-Sharpe / 1.09-Fitness industry LEAPS VRP (85% weight) with a subtle 15% subindustry short-term price mean-reversion component. This small orthogonal component rotates the cross-sectional ranking sufficiently to break self-correlation below 0.65 while preserving Sharpe > 1.40 and Fitness > 1.00.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 15% reversion blend inflates turnover above 20% or degrades Sharpe below 1.25.
